feeds.title: Feminist Book Club » Social Justice
feeds.description: Social justice is critical to being involved in your community. Check out Feminist Book Club's blog archive packed with information and articles about social justice. The Feminist Book Club is an award-winning feminist media and book subscription using literature as a launchpad to have meaningful conversations about social justice.

feeds.title: Social Justice Books
feeds.description: Explore a critically reviewed selection of multicultural and social justice books for children, young adults, and educators. SocialJusticeBooks.org is a project of Teaching for Change, a non-profit organization whose mission is to provide teachers and parents with the tools to create schools where students learn to read, write, and change the world.

feeds.title: She Seeks Nonfiction » Social Justice
feeds.description: Read articles on Social Justice. She Seeks Nonfiction features the thoughts and musings of Rebekah, a lifelong student, curious atheist, creative introvert, and intersectional feminist. She loves to read and write about social justice, atheism, religion, science history, human evolution, and more.

feeds.title: Seattle Book Mama » Social Justice
feeds.description: Enjoy in-depth reviews and summaries of books that involve themes of Social Justice and diversity. Browse different perspectives as characters from multiple cultures and backgrounds interact and move the story. Seattle Book Mama is a book blog by Donna Davis, a a retired teacher who has now taken to clearing out her TBR list.

feeds.title: Adventures in Reading, Running and Working From Home » Social Justice Race
feeds.description: Book blogger Elizabeth is an editor, transcriber, reader, reviewer, writer, and runner. Discover thought-provoking reviews and summaries in the Social Justice Category, focusing on books that explore themes of diversity. Engage with different viewpoints as characters from varied cultures and backgrounds contribute to the narrative richness.

feeds.title: Rethinking Schools
feeds.description: Rethinking Schools is a nonprofit publisher and advocacy organization dedicated to sustaining and strengthening public education through social justice teaching and education activism. Our magazine, books, and other resources promote equity and racial justice in the classroom.

feeds.title: Teaching Social Justice with Children's Books Blog
feeds.description: Teaching Social Justice blog uses children's books to address the Common Core and Learning for Justice's Social Justice Standards. Experience a tapestry of perspectives as characters from diverse cultures and backgrounds shape the narrative landscape.

feeds.title: 6 Elements of Social Justice Ed.
feeds.description: Dive into Children's Literature on Social Justice. 6 Elements of Social Justice Ed. features an annotated list of children's literature for the elementary classroom. The books are organized by the Six Elements of Social Justice Curriculum Design (Picower, 2007). It is based on work by pre-service teachers at Montclair State University.

feeds.description: Find comprehensive reviews and summaries of books centered on diversity themes. Witness the interplay of perspectives as characters from diverse cultures and backgrounds come to life. She's Probably at the Library is a blog by Stephanie where she reads and dissects anything she finds interesting.

feeds.title: The Lerner Blog » Social Justice
feeds.description: Join The Lerner Blog in an exploration of gripping Social Justice literature with insightful reviews and summaries. Founded in 1959, Lerner Publishing Group is one of the nation's largest independent children's book publishers creating high-quality fiction and nonfiction for children and young adults.

feeds.title: Introverted Reader » Social Justice
